hints.title: Character Frequency Counting
hints.text: Count the total occurrences of each character in the string.

hints.title: Threshold Filtering
hints.text: Identify which characters meet the frequency requirement of appearing at least k times.

hints.title: Order Preserving Construction
hints.text: Iterate through the original string and append characters meeting the frequency criterion.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Two pass linear scan: one to count frequencies, one to filter.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning the string repeatedly for each character takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Frequency map requires O(U) space bounded by alphabet size.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use a hash map or array counter to preserve character order.
